# Know Your Meme & Scientific American

> > A mixed collection documenting viral internet memes, TikTok trends, and scientific content from Know Your Meme and Scientific American.

This site appears to combine meme documentation and cultural phenomenon explainers (primarily from Know Your Meme) with select Scientific American content. The majority of content focuses on viral TikTok trends, exploitable memes, and internet culture explanations.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Viral meme explanations and guides
- Internet slang and catchphrases
- Breaking Bad references
- Hood culture and 90s nostalgia
- Mental health memes
- Looksmaxxing culture
- Social media platforms (Twitter/X, Facebook, Reddit)
- Millennial culture
- Conspiracy theories
- Dance memes
- Pop culture references

- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl? The Viral Memes About Somali-American ICE Vi... | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Explainer on Nasra Ahmed viral ICE incident memes from Minneapolis
- [What Does 'Clavicular Brutally Frame Mogged By ASU Frat Leader' Mean? The Viral Conspiracy Theory Linking 'Labubu Dolls' To The... | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/are-labubus-demonic-the-viral-conspiracy-theory-linking-labubu-dolls-to-the-demon-pazuzu-explained): Explainer debunking viral Labubu doll demon Pazuzu conspiracy theory

## Catchphrase & Dialogue Memes

- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White and Jesse Pinkman
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok

## TikTok Trends & Dance Memes

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring girl and cat, viral on TikTok and social media
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' song catchphrase
- [Millennial Burger Place | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): TikTok trend mocking stereotypical millennial burger restaurant cliches

## Meme Collections & Culture

- [22 Memes About Mental Health That Are A Little Too Relatable | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/collections/22-memes-about-mental-health-that-are-a-little-too-relatable): Collection of relatable mental health memes about depression and anxiety
